name: Lindt Excellence 85% Cocoa Dark Chocolate (High Caffeine & Motility Warning)
whyItWorks: 85% dark chocolate contains high concentrations of cocoa solids rich in caffeine and theobromine. These methylxanthine compounds stimulate rapid peristaltic contractions in the colon, triggering sudden urgent diarrhea and cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Motility Warning: Avoid dark chocolate (>70% cocoa) during flare-ups or active diarrhea. Choose mild milk chocolate or white chocolate in remission.
watchOuts: Potent gut stimulant: high caffeine and theobromine dramatically accelerate colonic transit.
